listitem.para: Whether to negotiate the IKEv2 optimized rekey (draft-ietf-ipsecme-ikev2-sa-ts-payloads-opt) in IKE_AUTH. When both peers have exchanged the OPTIMIZED_REKEY_SUPPORTED notification, a rekey may omit the SA (and for the Child SA the TS) payloads from the CREATE_CHILD_SA exchange, as the new SA inherits the properties of the SA being rekeyed. A regular rekey is always accepted.

Optimized Child SA rekeys keeps the mode (tunnel, transport or IP-TFS) of the Child SA it replaces. Child SAs using compression, or on an IKE SA that used a PPK, are rekeyed with a regular rekey. The first rekey of a Child SA created in IKE_AUTH is a regular rekey, unless child-sa-pfs-info-supported was negotiated. When the peer rejects an optimized rekey with NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN, a regular rekey is tried.
